description: Answers which HUD Section 232 program fits an assisted living, memory care or nursing home (223(f), 223(a)(7), new construction/substantial rehab or 241(a)) from the same questions as the Route 232 chooser, with eligibility warnings, and returns that program's published rules: who qualifies, loan limits, coverage, mortgage insurance and fees, required reports and the HUD median closing time. Pass "program" alone to get one program's rules.

goal.description: Only when has_fha_loan is true: a lower rate or payment, or money for improvements or an addition.

has_fha_loan.description: Does the building have an FHA-insured (HUD) loan today?

independent_living_over_25pct.description: Are more than a quarter of the beds independent living?

licensed_20_plus_beds.description: Licensed or regulated by the state, with 20 or more beds?

operating.description: Only when has_fha_loan is false: is the building open and operating (false = building new or gutting it)?

program.description: Skip the questions and return the rules of one program: 223f (refinance or purchase), 223a7 (streamlined refinance of an FHA loan), new-construction (new construction or substantial rehab) or 241a (supplemental loan).

years_since_completion.description: Only when operating is true: years since the building was completed or last substantially rehabilitated.

name: which_232_program
title: Which HUD Section 232 loan fits
